# cb:b513

> Make mix cb.import validate id-namespace consistency: a spec whose new-belief ids lack the graph's namespace prefix (bare b484 in a cb:-namespaced graph) should be normalized or rejected, and the moduledoc example (lib/mix/tasks/cb.import.ex, which shows a bare 'a305') corrected. Today the task stores spec ids verbatim, so a bare-id batch lands silently inconsistent.
